svg.title: Porting pull requests and releases
svg.desc: From May 12 through August 21, 128 port pull request merges are shown as blue bubbles whose area is proportional to additions plus deletions, and 135 public package releases are shown as gray prerelease and green stable-release dots. The largest port pull requests cluster near the completion of the port.
svg.text: Blue bubble area is proportional to changed lines; gray release dots are prereleases and green dots are stable.
